description: Source code for the TimeClient Request Handler in a TR-069 host interface, managing time synchronization, configuration, and notifications.

classes.name: TimeClientReqHandler
classes.description: Handles TR-069 time client requests, including get/set operations, notifications, and updates.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set requests for device time parameters.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get requests for device time parameters, including local time, timezone, status, and UTC time.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback for time update events.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Handles get attribute requests, mainly for notification setup.

methods.name: handleSetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Handles set attribute requests, mainly for notification setup.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for time-related updates and triggers callbacks if needed.
